title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Nobody — the data does. Materials for the EEAI 2026 talk (Malta, 19–21 October 2026)
description: Code, raw results, figures and bibliography behind the EEAI 2026 talk. On 100 date-anchored questions over the versioned French tax code (fiscal-fr-bench), three independent LLM judges and a calibrated decision model certify wrong answers whenever the error is invisible in the evidence they share; a bitemporal journal with deterministic as-of resolution catches every such answer with no model, and makes model size stop mattering (97–99 of 100 for gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5.4-mini and gpt-5.4). Every number is recomputable from the included JSON with verify.py.
